## Purpose 
Our "run_fluxnet" runs rely on parameters (that are not necessarily correct/are unknown for these sites) and parameterizations (That we have chosen not to use in global runs because they dont perform as well). Therefore the run_fluxnet script produces output that doesnt reflect our model.

This PR simplifies to have a single run_generic_site script which uses the global model setup. We retain the vaira_paper script which reads in specific parameters for the site (and also looks really bad right now, much worse than our paper version) as an example (that we should fix) and the ozark_pft example. Because we use the default in the fluxnet runs, we can remove the ozark_pmodel script.
